en: Bring Back a Bang
Retrieve $1oa Stolen Explosives from the Dark Iron Dwarf camps.

The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.

I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!

I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
This war against the Dark Irons just keeps going on and on!

Ach, that's a load off me mind. At least the Dark Irons won't be able to roll a bomb-cart into our wagons... or lob 'em in a trebuchet... or roll 'em down the hill at us... or feed 'em tae slimes and then let the slimes loose near are camp and set 'em on fire.$B$BNow we just have tae make sure the powder stays dry!$B$BThanks!
Accessories of the Lost
Bring back Essene's Necklace, Essene's Spellbook, and Essene's Waterskin.

While I was fleeing from those Dark Irons, I wound up dropping lots of my gear!

It looks like I lost... my green leather waterskin, my spellbook, my necklace, and... well I need these things!

If you can find them while I repack and catch my breath, that would be a great help.
Sentiments of the Lost
Bring Essene's note back to Corma Villard.

I just need to finish repacking, and I can get out of here!

If you'll do me one last favor, here--take this note to Corma. It'll let her know that I'm alive and I'm on my way!
Slay the Spitelash
Kill 8 Spitelash Warriors and 8 Spitelash Screamers for Commander Truesong in Azshara.

Azshara may appear beautiful, but it is a cursed place. There are horrors deep beneath its waters, waiting to emerge and tear the world asunder.

All we can do for now is fight the horrors that have already surfaced.

The Spitelash Naga occupy the Ruins of Eldarath to the north east. The ones within the ruins are well-fortified, so we must pick off the weaker ones along the outskirts first.

As you can see, we could always use another fighter here, if you are up to the task.
Preserving Eldarath
Collect $1oa Eldarath Relics from Spitelash Serpent Guards, Spitelash Sirens, and Spitelash Myrmidons, and Lord Sarthiss' Head for Commander Truesong in Azshara.

Millennia ago, Eldarath was a sight to behold; a living testament to the glory and might of the Kaldorei. What we call Eldarath today is hardly a pile of rubble by comparison.

Nonetheless, what remains is worth salvaging, if only to preserve our history. The Spitelash must be driven out before Eldarath is completely ransacked.

Following the road north east will lead you right into the heart of the ruins. Go there, and retrieve as many of our relics as you can--and their commander's head.
Reclaiming Ravencrest
Kill 5 Spitelash Battlemasters, 5 Spitelash Enchantresses, and nullify the 3 Naga Power Stones near Ravencrest Monument for Commander Truesong in Azshara.

I fear time may soon forget the Kaldorei house of Ravencrest. A lone, crumbling, monument is the only surviving proof of their presence here.

The monument can be found atop the cliffs at the very tip of the southern peninsula. Spitelash enchantresses there have a set of power stones which they use to channel their magic. Take this ward, and nullify them. This will cripple the Spitelash's magic, and give us an upper hand in driving them out.

While you're at it, be sure to take out a few naga yourself.
The Head of the Serpent
Bring Warlord Krellian's head to Commander Truesong in Azshara.

Your final target is Warlord Krellian, the leader of the Spitelash. He cowers behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor in the ruins of Eldarath.

Cut off Krelian's head, and his minions will be slithering back to the sea in fear. Then, finally, Azshara will belong to Kaldorei once again.
Making Contact
Find the Kaldorei woman last seen on the Shattered Strand.

While scouting along the cliffs of the Shattered Strand, one of our sentinels noticed a kaldorei woman on the beach.

Clearly, she is not with our expedition, and she did not have the makings of a fighter. I wonder then, what she could be doing in such a hostile place as this.

If you can, try to make contact with her. I would like to know her purpose for being here, and if our interests are perhaps aligned.

She was last seen on the eastern coast, along the north side of the Bay of Storms.
Saving a Sentinel
Help Keldara Sunblade escape the Haldarr Encampment, then speak to Commander Truesong at Talrendis Point.

<The sentinel speaks in a low whisper>

Listen, $c, before they hear us. I am a sentinel from Talrendis Point. The satyr here believe me injured, but I am only feigning; waiting for the moment they drop their guard and I can escape.

Your arrival is perhaps such a moment.

Help me out of here, would you?
Highborne Tablets
Find the three highborne tablets among the ruins of Southridge Beach, then bring them to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.

Just south of here, along the beach, there are some tablets of highborne writing. They document the highborne's investigations into the laws and powers of the arcane. 

The tablets are being kept in pagoda-like structures, guarded by naga, so I wouldn't dare attempt to procure them myself.

Fortunately, I've found myself a new assistant! 

So, what do you say? Think you could be of further use in the pursuit of knowledge?
Slithering Looters
Find the Staff of Archmage Selwyn among the Ruins of Eldarath, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.

I came here in search of highborne artifacts. You could call me an archaeologist of sorts.

The ruins of Eldarath to the west hold many of them, although the naga are looting the ruins as we speak.

A naga called Lady Sesspira leads the pillaging; no doubt keeping the best finds for herself. 

If my research is correct, I believe she may be in possession of the staff of Archmage Selwyn, a fallen highborne mage.

I need your help to get that staff, $r. Scholars like me are ill-suited for combat.
